summary.answer: Reads scoreboard column names 0,1,2, lowercases each and calls CreatedSortKey in the same order with scoreboard. prefix. No missing-name/type guard or actual sorting occurs here. Gets focused element model; if present and controller.currentFocusedClient exists writes that model into it. Then always invokes UpdateScoreboardClientMuteButtonPrompt, even if no model was found. Resolves controller.clientModel's value/clientNum, searches the list by that number; if found assigns savedActiveIndex from gridInfoTable.zeroBasedIndex. No immediate focus event or absent-controller/client guards are shown. Subscribes the owner to the exact scoreboard-open visibility model; each delivered callback calls SetCurrentFocusedClientToLocalPlayer(list,controller) without checking the delivered bit value. No eager reset or unsubscribe is shown.

summary.answer: Creates controller TeamIdentity.ColorList model, loops all color-table rows, reads RGB numbers, creates color_N children with id and formatted RGB string, appends their models and returns the list. No old children removal or missing-table recovery is shown. Creates controller TeamIdentity.LogoList, loops all logo rows, reads name/icon strings, creates logo_N models with id/name/ref, appends them and returns model list. It does not fetch or render logos itself. Only for CodCaster reads deadSpectator.playerIndex, searches both team lists, prefers your-team match, takes its model, sends gain_focus and marks _readyForCustomFocus. If currentFocusedClient exists and a model replaced INVALID_CLIENT_INDEX sets it. No found item means no write; unguarded spectator model remains literal.
